## About
Our founder, Steve Walowitz, set out to create energy-efficient windows and maintenance free exteriors, and to add the details that give a house real curb-side appeal. We work out of our shop on Commercial Ave in Northbrook.
Along with installing windows, exterior decorating has become a huge part of what we do: porticos with columns, pergolas, arbors, flowerboxes, shutters, mantels, keystones and pilasters. Our exterior planner visits your home, gets to know your tastes and asks for your wish list. Then our in-house Graphic Art department draws it up for your review.
Homeowners rate us 4.8 from 52 Google reviews. Reviewers mention Ken by name, and one said he "showed up and pretty much saved the day."

## Services
- Exterior Designs: All the elements to give the outside of your home a new, distinctive look, planned around your tastes and your wish list.
- Windows & Patio Doors: Windows including bays, bows and garden windows, plus patio doors.
- Siding: JamesHardie®, LP Smart Side®, Alside®, Revolution®, Wolverine®, Certainteed® and Cedar siding in a variety of colors and styles.
- Doors: A specialty line of front entry doors and patio doors, custom designed. One reviewer finished their project with a slider, a French door and a new front door.
- Porticos: Custom porticos with columns, planned for your home. One reviewer said their new portico added beautiful architectural detail.
- Pergolas: A pergola can accent your garden, patio or entrance way, giving you a personal getaway or a spot for entertaining guests.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Call us at (847) 559-5224 or fill out the simple form on our site to get a personalized free estimate.

Q: Is the free exterior plan available for any project?
A: The free exterior plan is only available with a whole house siding purchase. Our sales representative can give you the details.

Q: Can you work within my budget?
A: Yes. We tailor your project to fit within your budget, and one reviewer said Ken brought ideas that fit both their neighborhood and their budget.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Homes across the Chicago metro and suburbs, including Northbrook, Arlington Heights, Glenview, Wilmette, Highland Park, Palatine, Barrington and more.

Q: When is your office open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
